message.content:
<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
Brad has confirmed that there are no other available slots for Elena and David. I have also confirmed that there are no other available slots for Priya and Marcus. We have exhausted all possibilities. The meeting, as requested, cannot be scheduled.

This is unfortunate, but it is the conclusion we have reached after a thorough search. I should now use the `report_infeasible` tool to formally communicate this. I will provide a clear reason, stating that there is no common 30-minute slot available for all four partners next week.
</SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>

function.name: report_infeasible
function.arguments: {"reason":"After a thorough review of all four partners' calendars, there are no 30-minute time slots available for a meeting next week (Monday, November 16 to Friday, November 20, 2026, from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM Eastern)."}
